scope: Bounded native records, answer admission and local tool-planner experiment
sourceBinding: Final hashes bind partial-answer-guard-01, question-isolated-01 and public-answer-guard-03. Earlier intermediate revisions were not individually hashed; exact commands, result bundles, identifiers, failures and diagnostic traces remain retained.
policy: macOS MCP/native tools first; integration/context/answer failures are not demonstrated visual-model needs
One build/test/inference at a time, Xcode jobs 1, no source edits during builds/tests
12 GB whole-Mac target; standalone model worker stops above sampled 4 GiB
No purchases, account login, messages, pushes, releases or production model selection changes

recordWindows.tested: All captured records and ancestors retained within 32 texts/24 links/6KiB per view

answerAdmission.tested: Executed numeric/source/URL-digit reds; actual false answers withheld; partial view cannot finish or claim tool incapability
answerAdmission.accepted: Observed rejection boundaries, not general semantics

controlledMCPWorkflow.tested: 11.16 seconds, exact answer, one visit per page, actual MCP link verification, zero CU calls

publicWholeGoal.tested: Unchanged public oracle remains failed; final result nil, contextLimit, zero CU calls

alternateToolPlanner.compiled: Python preflight and b9992 load, no production adapter
alternateToolPlanner.tested: See exact model reports and separate judgement

findings: Bounded views preserve native data; this Apple planner does not retain a verified whole-goal evidence set across views, so completion remains withheld there.
Free-form memory proposals and unused cursor experiment removed; no source/site names or expected answer values enter production.
Explicit English month/day/year normalizes to the same civil day; no inferred year, relative date or numeric-date locale.
Scalar/source admission does not prove association, semantic completeness, arithmetic or nonnumeric accuracy, and can conservatively reject unsupported formatting.
Combined-run clarification continuation failed with InvalidTransition, then passed alone on unchanged source; its cause remains unresolved.
Existing compiler and main-thread responsiveness warnings remain.
Normal prepared HostSession, query generation, varied sites/native apps, provider login, phone handoff and 12 GB whole-Mac/heat acceptance remain open.

publicOracle.goal: Open https://github.com/apple/swift-nio/releases. Find the latest stable release and report its version, publication date in YYYY-MM-DD format, and the official link for that release.

nextEvidence: Reliable local tool planning and verified whole-goal evidence retention before enabling answers across record views.
Stage-specific native evidence for the combined continuation failure if it recurs.
Normal HostSession, real provider and phone controls, varied web/native tasks and whole-Mac resource qualification.
